findings: Acoustic releases expose studio-title collisions; direct exact title and artist are insufficient without verified release context.
Album track matching needs conservative support for track-number prefixes, translated aliases and non-Latin catalog titles.
MusicBrainz track artist and album artist must be stored separately; remix compilations often credit a guest recording artist while Roon requires the album artist for navigation.
Live catalog availability is release-specific; a studio identity candidate must remain rejected when the requested live album cannot be verified.
